title: docs(pm-dispatch): a dispatched PR carries its card's assignee — set at pr_create, moved on takeover
body:
Fixes #20063
Clause-②: no

## What this lands

Rule text only (the ruling: 「同意」 on the seat's recommendation quoted in the card) — no gate, no patrol row, no new tool.

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`, section 认领: the card assignee stays the PM's and the dev never writes it; **the PR assignee equals the card's**; the dev sets it in the same round as `pr_create` with `label-write.mjs --issue PR_NUMBER --assign LOGIN`; a seat's own PR is assigned to the seat; the takeover's step ② moves it in the same stroke; the reader is the filter `is:pr is:open assignee:LOGIN`.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, rule 2: "never write the assignee" narrowed to **the card's** assignee, with the PR spelling beside it; the write-budget line names the PR-assignee write as part of the `label-write` slot it already had. The objectui clause (path labels belong to `labeler.yml`) is unchanged.

The measured spelling comes from the card's pilot: objectstack-ai/objectui PRs 10410, 10412 and 10413 carry the cards' assignee, set through the relay's `assign` op on a PR number.

## Line budget (`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, both files at headroom 0)

| file | before | after | paid by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `execution-duties.md` | 183 | 183 | deleted, not re-wrapped: the clause 「原子对 step 1 设」 (line 60 of the same file states step ①), the clause 「跨账号 assignee 不是你 ⇒ 永不碰」 (SKILL.md's card-state row 「assignee 已设 … 不是你的就永不碰」 states it for every seat), and the line 「dev 每个可编译小步即 push …」 (a dev obligation that os-dev.md already carries as 「每个可编译小步即 commit + push … 接管只认远程分支最后 sha」) |
| `os-dev.md` | 402 | 402 | in-place rewrite of three existing lines, no line added |

Every changed line is at most 120 bytes (the same gate's width rule). The takeover line (step ②, 118 bytes) had no room for the increment, so the takeover half of the rule is stated on the rewritten assignee line as 「接管 ② 同笔换」.

The line 「释放是显式动作 …」 was a first candidate for payment (state-machine.md repeats it) and was deliberately kept: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` quotes that exact line as the protocol's own words (`RELEASE_ACT_RULE`), so removing its source would make that quotation unanswerable.

## Gates (all at head 6364f11)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran` → `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 20 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 20 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`

All twenty exit 0, among them `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (`✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: declared cross-file moves: 2, total ceilings down 477 lines.`), `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (`✓ check-skill-id-lint: 34 file(s) clean`), `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:agent-model-declared`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:commit-card-trailers`. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (a prerequisite not met: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were not built, so nothing was measured); it exited 0 after that build. Also run beyond the derivation: `check:pm-settings-deny-roster` and `check:pm-governed-prose`, both 0.

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the two paths: `GOVERNED — Tier S` (both under `.claude/**`). This PR lands after an in-seat contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, then goes through the queue. Nothing here is published (`.claude/**`), so it takes `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- A **release** of a card that still has an open PR (the card leaves ownership and nobody takes it over) is not covered by the ruling, so the PR assignee is left as it is. Only the takeover moves it.
- os-dev.md's objectui clause (「派发词未点名即零写」) is about labels; the PR-assignee write is set by rule 2 and the write-budget line, not by that clause.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:派发出的 PR 现在带卡的 assignee(派发席的关联用户账号)。dev 开 PR 后同一轮用 label-write 设置;接管卡时 PR 的 assignee 跟卡一起换人;席位自己开的 PR 指派给席位自己。改动只有两个规则文件里的几句话。
- **为什么改**:所有 PR 都由车队 bot 提交,看不出是谁在处理。按 assignee 过滤(`is:pr is:open assignee:LOGIN`)就能看到每个人名下在飞的 PR。维护者已裁决「同意」。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:两个文件行数不变。为腾出一行,删掉了三处在别的文件已写过的重复规则。没有新增门禁或巡查,所以漏设 assignee 的 PR 不会被自动发现。回滚方式:revert 本 PR。
- **席位意见**:
- **你要做的**:无需操作。本 PR 属 Tier S,由席位做达档复核后自行落地。AGENTS.md(Tier H)里 "never writes the assignee" 那句是否要写明「卡的」,由卡上的报告给出建议措辞,供你决定。
